nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Single place for every threshold. per_client_mib=441: Task 2.4 conservative per-client figure. backoff_seconds=5 is the LOCAL value; production should use 60.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.notes: Validation before any SSH. Rejects legacy slugs (jjbags-in, jj-bags-com, sa, qubix, ...) so no write node can ever match a legacy row.

nodes.name: Rec Invalid
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (redacted output only).

nodes.name: Get Client
nodes.notes: Read-only registry lookup for in-progress / already-active detection.

nodes.name: Rec Exists
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (redacted output only).

nodes.name: Preflight SSH
nodes.notes: READ-ONLY pre-flight. continueOnFail: an SSH failure yields an error item which Evaluate turns into blocked_preflight_failed (fail closed).

nodes.name: Evaluate
nodes.notes: available = free -m "available" column: already reflects both legacy stacks + OS (Task 2.4 requirement). Fail closed. debug_extra_reserve_mib can only INCREASE the reserve.

nodes.name: Rec Preflight
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (redacted output only).

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $('Evaluate').first().json }];

nodes.name: Proceed?
nodes.notes: The ONLY edge to any deployment node is this IF true branch.

nodes.name: Send Alert
nodes.notes: I4: retries 3x then CONTINUES; a failed alert is recorded as a provision_attempts row (phase alert, classification alert_failed) rather than vanishing.

nodes.name: Mark Provisioning
nodes.notes: C2 step (1): write-then-read claim. Upserts THIS run's row as `provisioning` BEFORE the pre-flight SSH, so a concurrent run sees it and fails closed. Only reachable once Check Existing has ruled out a pre-existing active / in-progress / legacy row, so a real client row is never overwritten.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ...$('Evaluate').first().json, attempt_no: 0, history: [] } }];

nodes.name: Prep Deploy
nodes.notes: All user values enter the command only via the q() single-quote-escaping helper. Bounded by max_attempts.

nodes.name: Deploy SSH
nodes.notes: Non-zero remote exit: see Classify. continueOnFail so SSH errors are classified transient (default-to-transient).

nodes.name: Classify
nodes.notes: Default-to-transient ruling (Task 4.3): 0 success; 1-9 terminal; 10-19 transient; anything else (125/127/255/null/signal/SSH error) transient. Password extracted and redacted before anything is persisted.

nodes.name: Rec Deploy
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (redacted output only).

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $('Classify').item.json }];

nodes.name: Mark Active
nodes.notes: Matches ONLY slug = the validated new-client slug. N6: retries 3x then CONTINUES, so a Data Table failure here can never strand a provisioned client with nobody told its password; the failure is recorded by Registry Eval instead.

nodes.name: Build Credentials Email
nodes.notes: Only place the generated admin password is emitted.

nodes.name: Send Credentials
nodes.notes: C1: retries 3x then CONTINUES. Delivery outcome is recorded as a provision_attempts row (phase credentials) so a lost password email is visible without opening execution data.

nodes.name: Teardown?
nodes.notes: Teardown only when Classify said transient AND owned_by_run (pre-flight proved project absent). Terminal never reaches here.

nodes.name: Mark Stopped
nodes.notes: Matches ONLY slug = the validated new-client slug. Legacy slugs are rejected in Validate, so legacy rows are unreachable.

nodes.name: Prep Teardown
nodes.notes: Throws unless owned_by_run === true.

nodes.name: Teardown SSH
nodes.notes: docker compose down -v for THIS run project only, then verify GONE.

nodes.name: Rec Teardown
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (redacted output only).

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $('Teardown Eval').item.json }];

nodes.name: Mark Final
nodes.notes: Matches ONLY slug = the validated new-client slug. Legacy slugs are rejected in Validate, so legacy rows are unreachable.

nodes.name: List Inflight
nodes.notes: C2 step (2): read every OTHER run currently claiming capacity. Read-only. alwaysOutputData so an empty result still lets Evaluate run.

nodes.name: Reset Claim
nodes.notes: C2 step (3): every non-deploying outcome clears this run's own `provisioning` claim so it cannot hold a phantom reservation for 2h. UPDATE (never upsert) matched on slug AND last_run_id = this run id, so no other run's row and no real client's row can be touched.

nodes.name: Delivery Eval
nodes.notes: C1: records whether the credentials email actually went out. No secret here.

nodes.name: Rec Delivery
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (phase credentials, no secrets).

nodes.name: Alert Eval
nodes.notes: I4: emits a row only when the alert could NOT be delivered.

nodes.name: Rec Alert
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (phase alert, classification alert_failed).

nodes.name: Registry Eval
nodes.notes: N6: emits a row only when Mark Active ultimately failed. No secret.

nodes.name: Rec Registry
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (phase registry, no secrets).

nodes.name: Prep Caddy
nodes.notes: Task 4.4. Runs generate-caddy-block.sh + apply-caddy-block.sh directly on the target (no nested SSH) from the fresh fleet checkout Deploy SSH already cloned for this client. Chained after Rec Delivery (the credentials pipeline's terminal node), not parallel to it -- proven empirically that this n8n instance serializes fan-out siblings regardless of connection order, so an explicit sequential dependency is what actually guarantees credentials are never delayed by this step.

nodes.name: Caddy SSH
nodes.notes: Non-zero remote exit: see Caddy Eval. continueOnFail so SSH errors are classified failed, not thrown.

nodes.name: Caddy Eval
nodes.notes: Non-fatal by design: runs after credentials are already sent (see Prep Caddy's note), so a failure here can never affect delivery, and it never triggers teardown either -- the app stack is up and reachable regardless. Recorded via Rec Caddy's provision_attempts row (phase 'caddy') only; not surfaced in the credentials email, since Caddy hasn't run yet when that email is built.

nodes.name: Rec Caddy
nodes.notes: Records one provision_attempts row (phase caddy, no secrets).
